newsitem.title: USA: Michael Foods sees Q2 exit from frozen potato unit.
newsitem.headline: Michael Foods sees Q2 exit from frozen potato unit.

text.p: Michael Foods Inc's frozen french fry business trimmed $0.03 a share off 1997 first quarter earnings and the company said Monday it expects to exit the business in the second quarter.

"We will be out of the frozen french fry business before the current quarter ends and are focused on re-building momentum in the refrigerated potato products area," said Chief Executive Officer Gregg Ostrander in a statement.
Earlier today, the company reported its 1997 first quarter earnings rose to $4 million or $0.20 a share from $3.3 million or $0.17 in 1996's first quarter.
